A lot of the cargo is food and such, but
there are foreign specialties and pricey stuff
in there too, you know.
Oops, if I slack off too much,

Apparently somebody skims valuable goods off the cargo and secretly
makes a profit
Way down south along Harbor Street,
there's a warehouse nobody uses now, and

Secretly hauling cargo in there and
selling it off. A young man

A trading ship passing by came to rescue

My family probably died, but
they let me stay on and work aboard the
trading ship.
That's why I'm so grateful to the captain.
To repay the captain who rescued me at sea,
